scope: Fresh read-only public GitHub and Hugging Face metadata and small source-file inspection. No adapter, direction tensor, checkpoint or model payload was downloaded or executed; no publisher was contacted.

approvedAdapter.identityBasis: The existing config/swift-lora.lock.json and the freshly read immutable publisher README name this same file, size and SHA-256. This audit did not download or rehash the adapter.

currentPublicRepository.observation: The complete current main tree contains the adapter, direction files, runtime examples and exporter, without an unfolded checkpoint or a manifest of the exact adapter-authoring invocation.

sourceFiles.observation: Names the approved adapter digest and states that rebuilding requires an unfolded fp16 checkpoint which this repository does not ship.

Accepts arbitrary checkpoint and direction paths, converts the direction to float32 and divides by its norm. The output metadata records adapter type and alpha, without checkpoint, conversion-run or direction-input identities. The optional mapping check examines block zero only and supplies no retained all-48 native-SSM proof.

Public metadata describes a 5120-dimensional unit-norm vector in the unrotated hidden basis and 129 residual writers, including 48 linear-attention outputs. This is available direction documentation, not a record binding the exact shipped adapter to its authoring inputs.

sourceDigestMethod: SHA-256 over each complete raw HTTP response body before text decoding; no canonical JSON or Git-object digest substitution.

publicDirectionFileMetadata.gitObjectDigestScope: SHA-1 identifies the Git blob object, including its object header. These identifiers are not raw-file SHA-256 digests.

referencedPackedModel.observation: The listed files provide the compressed pack and its runtime, without a manifest binding an unfolded authoring checkpoint to the approved adapter.

huggingFaceMetadata.limit: These public listings do not establish the absence of material under other accounts or of private or unpublished inputs; those remain unknown.

remainingRequirements: Obtain immutable unfolded-checkpoint shard/tensor identities and the conversion invocation or manifest tied to the exact approved adapter SHA-256, including the actual direction input, normalization and relevant tool versions.

Declare the authoring-to-native SSM channel mapping, transform/sign inputs and intended Swift loader/graph identities; independently verify every shipped SSM A vector at all 48 sites with declared numerical bounds and retained per-site results.

Retain independent native writer-input/correction evidence and matched no-adapter, loaded-zero and nonzero logits/live-state controls for the intended released runtime and worker policy. Runtime agreement does not recover missing authoring provenance.
